title: DeepSeek Tools Manager
description: Adds a floating toolbar to DeepSeek chat with useful tools: soft refresh, cache clearing, auto-refresh timer, and memory checker. Mobile responsive with smooth animations.

title: Selected Text Color Changer
description: Remove Selected Text Highlight and change Text Color to Kakoi Kiraku Accent Color when selected.

title: Icon Color Changer
description: Changes SVG and FontAwesome icons color to Kakoi Kiraku Accent Color on all sites.

title: Long Press Highlight Disabler
description: Disables the blue highlight on long press for URLs and elements with embedded URLs

title: GitHub Kakoi Kiraku Theme
description: Applies Kakoi Kiraku Theme to GitHub repositories with card-styles.

title: Sidebar Utilities
description: Sidebar with utilities to make browsing more easier in mobile. This Sidebar Utilities included: Hard Refresh, Scroll to Top and Down, Clear Cookies & Data and Image Grabber. Double click the sidebar to open the Tools.

title: Allow Playing Videos in the Background
description: A working YouTube and Vimeo video background player. Original file from default Cromite User Script settings.
